decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system sits squarely in the firm's core coolant-management portfolio and, after surviving its first full year, is likely to be retained as part of integrated customer solutions.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens the established filtration and process-media business and should remain attractive for a large machinery supplier building service and system sales.
The coolant nozzles line supports cross-selling into the installed base and offers modular variants, so a full withdrawal in the coming year is still unlikely.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor fits the firm's established chip-handling offer and complements broader automation and production-support systems, making continuation the likely choice.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is a sensible adjacent product but, as a somewhat less central extension and after the earlier withdrawal of another conveyor variant, it carries the highest rationalization risk among the remaining launches.
